offering_description.value: Integer designs and manufactures finished medical devices and components for medical device companies. It helps customers develop, test and scale production of products for cardiovascular procedures, cardiac rhythm management, neuromodulation and other medical uses.

primary_products.value: catheters and delivery systems; guidewires; implantable leads and electrodes; implantable batteries; portable medical device components

primary_services.value: device design and engineering; prototyping; verification testing; contract manufacturing and assembly

customer_segment.value: B2B: Medical device manufacturers, including established OEMs and emerging device developers

end_markets.value: cardiovascular intervention; cardiac rhythm management; neuromodulation; portable medical equipment; orthopedics

revenue_model.value: product sales: Finished medical devices and components supplied to OEM customers; project or contract: Device development and custom manufacturing under customer agreements

value_chain_position.value: component supplier: Turns metals, polymers and electronic parts into components sold to medical device OEMs; OEM / manufacturer: Builds and assembles finished medical devices for OEM customers; service provider: Takes OEM design requirements through engineering, prototyping and testing
value_chain_position.category: component supplier; OEM / manufacturer; service provider

geography_served.value: global: Serves customers worldwide, with manufacturing in the United States, Mexico and Europe

specialization.value: related lines: Cardiovascular devices, cardiac rhythm and neuromodulation products, and other medical components

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Direct supply and development relationships with medical device OEMs

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Medical device manufacturing subject to FDA quality system requirements and applicable EU medical device rules
